subject: Site Facelift!
author: ZombieTron
body:
The facelift looks great! I love the new tabs at the top for the games, the menus are much clearer and easier to navigate (although it took me a couple of seconds to see where to log out! it's now at the top right!!)

When I did log out, the site looks a lot cleaner and inviting for new visitors, and the log in/register box is in a more accessible place. Hopefully this will encourage more visitors to sign up and join our community.

PS3 users have now got their gamercard on the site, which 360'ers have had for a while.

Nice Job Xandu! and now we get to PLAY!! 🙂 🎮
